fixes.explanation: Yes, baker. Romans 8:3 says God did it “…by sending His own Son in the likeness of sinful man, as an offering for sin.” The law couldn't do it, so God did it by sending His Son. I'm just standing here with my mustache in the air.
That's it, baker. Romans 8:6 says, “The mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace…” Life AND peace. Read that one twice, because it sounds even better the second time.

True, baker, and it's a big one. Romans 8:11 says, “…He who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit, who lives in you.” Notice the "if" at the start: if the Spirit of the One who raised Jesus lives in you. I'd shout, but my mustache is already waving.

Priests, huh? That's a fair guess, friend, but it isn't the word Paul uses here. Romans 8:17 says, “And if we are children, then we are heirs: heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ…” Paul goes from children straight to heirs. He's talking about what children receive, not a job they do.
